description.value:
You detonate a bolt of frigid energy at a point you designate within range. Every creature caught in the resulting 5-foot-radius burst must attempt a Dexterity saving throw. Those who fail suffer 3d6 cold damage and are slowed by 1 level until your next turn begins; those who succeed take half damage and avoid the slow effect.

Cast with a tech slot of 3rd level or higher, the cold damage grows by 1d6 per slot level beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
